rules.dailyReset: local calendar day, monotonic, no rewards on clock rollback
rules.miningTapAction: one strike spent per valid tap on unbroken stone; no match-three swaps
rules.rockContents: deterministic per site seed and stable x,y tile key; hidden until fully cracked
rules.orePayout: only on completed excavation, into cart if room; otherwise remains as unclaimed ore on exposed tile
rules.siteRegeneration: only when every current tile excavated and all exposed ore claimed; never on navigation/reload
rules.gloveSurvey: free of strike cost; once per new unscanned tile; shows ore yes/no only, not class or precise yield
rules.cartUnload: free action, transfers cart ore to persistent refinery ore stock; no loss or sell-through
rules.refineryFlow: cart ore -> stored ore -> refined metal -> manufactured goods -> Nutvale Dollars -> Writs
rules.mineMapUpgrade: adds row and column; keeps previous coordinate identities and excavation state; no new site roll
rules.toolUpgradeEffect: pickaxe +5 max daily strikes; gloves +1 daily survey; same-day upgrade grants only newly added capacity
rules.currencyStorage: saved.nutravaganza.dollars is sole Nutvale Dollars balance; mine inventories nested in saved.nutravaganzaExpedition
rules.expeditionLedger: saved.nutravaganzaExpedition.stars and unlocked, never saved.stars or saved.unlocked

migration: Preserve existing ore, writs, mineTier, seed, stars, unlocked and day values
Convert old length-16 site array to stable x,y excavation keys
Already excavated legacy rocks never pay their ore a second time
Map old picks to remaining strikes without a new same-day refill
Remove legacy direct ore-to-writ refine path; Writ purchases spend N$ only
Atomic transactions prevent duplicated ore, metal, goods, N$ or Writs

ui.entry: Homestead / Nutvale hub -> Nutvale Mines -> Dig Board / Workshop / Refinery / Writ Office
ui.board: responsive square 4x4 to 9x9 with familiar large tappable tiles, top mini-wallet, strike and scan modes; no large empty headers
ui.feedback: shake/crack per strike, reveal on final strike, ore flight to cart; show barren rock honestly
ui.shop: single compact upgrade list, visible next-tier cost and exact effect before confirmation
ui.odds: exact tier-specific rock outcome percentage, hardness chances, scan probability unaffected by purchases
ui.accessibility: 44px touch targets where feasible, text labels and distinct rock silhouettes for color blindness, reduced-motion mode

artSourceApproval.state: approved source renders from conversation; not yet present as verified repository assets
artSourceApproval.rule: Keep tap rock cells, equipment, carts, ores and buttons as independent UI/sprite layers; decorative squirrel workers are NPCs only

qualityGates: All 6 boards render; existing tile coordinates and excavation progress survive upgrades/reload
No ore from barren stone; odds match disclosed tier probabilities for all rock outcomes
Strikes and scans consume correct daily budgets; invalid/full/excavated taps do not spend
Ore never disappears when cart full; exposed unclaimed deposits remain redeemable
Reenter mine, foreground/background app, backward-clock and restart cannot reroll an opened site
Refinery and workshop deduct inputs atomically; sales credit only one N$ balance
Writ buys spend N$180 exactly; 1 Writ debited per admitted expedition attempt
Five 100-level areas use IDs 1001-1500 and preserve trials 501-650 and base campaign 1-500
No first-campaign stars/rewards/unlocked state modified when second campaign levels complete
Shop odds/upgrade yields accurate; no undisclosed rewards or paywall
No release-certified claims until actual device minigame endurance and package smoke tests
